newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq posts small gain, tempered by large techs.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq posts small gain, tempered by large techs.

text.p: Nasdaq shares ended slightly higher on Tuesday but gains were tempered as several large technology stocks gave back yesterday's gains, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 2.61 points, or 0.19 percent, to close at 1347.69. But the gain was narrow, with advancing issues about even with decliners.
"With the techs, it's just see-saw activity," one trader said. "There are no major gains and no major losses. It's just a day-to-day mood change while people feel out the sector."

Cisco Systems Inc dropped 2-1/2 to 56-1/2 after the networking equipment maker said international sales growth is slowing in certain markets. Microsoft Corp shed 5/8 to 99-1/2. Intel Corp eased 1/8 to 148-7/8 and ClinTrials Research Inc plunged 13-3/4 to 9-1/2 after the company warned that its first quarter would fall below last year's results and a brokerage firm downgraded the stock.
IONA Technologies Ltd made a strong debut in its initial public offering. IONA's American Depositary Shares (ADS) gained 3-5/8 to 21-5/8.
